liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Easy to Love You** (1 review, 2 other sources): Brought back after a ten-year absence; First played since 9/3/80 [1][6][21]
- **Terrapin** (3 reviews): Reviewer found the Terrapin extremely long and welcomed that; The jam out of Terrapin seems to toy with a theme, and the drummers later pick up its beat [13][14][15]
- **Althea (1) $** (1 review, 1 other source): Crowd roars loudly at the 'this place is getting hot' line; This Althea appears on the release Without A Net [8][21]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 other sources): Happy Birthday was sung for Phil just before China Cat Sunflower; China Cat opens with a Happy Birthday intro [6][8]
- **Revolution** (1 review, 1 other source): Playing Revolution in that venue after the police hassles really hit the spot; First played since 11/8/85 [1][23]
- **Tom Thumb Blues** (1 review): Reviewer's first live Tom Thumb's Blues, which felt special [20]
- **Mock Turtle Jam > (2)** (1 review): The jam coming out of Terrapin is officially titled Mock Turtle Jam [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **Easy to Love You**: back after 710 archived shows (3480 days) [24]
- **crowd sings Happy Bday**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **Mock Turtle Jam > (2)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **Revolution**: back after 313 archived shows (1588 days); rare: 12 archived performances [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-03-15.AUD.LaPorte.115935.Flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 165 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1990-03-15.28293.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 23 songs; 162 min; rated 4.26/5 by 42 [2]. Said about its sound: Audience recording with weaker sound, though the crowd roar is nostalgic; Reviewer calls this source weak and says the official Terrapin Station release sounds great [21][22]
- **gd1990-03-15.140985.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 171 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [6]
- **gd1990-03-15.142545.OTS.Schoeps.Mattes.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: source not stated; 20 songs; 180 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [8]
- **gd1990-03-15.senn-hubbard.cpb.83675.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 150 min; rated 3.25/5 by 4 [11]

## Around the show

- The show fell on Phil's 50th birthday [17]
- First-time attendee, stage left, saw a glowing halo above Jerry's head late in the second set [19]
- Maryland police at Landover were remembered as tough [20]
- Police outside were brutal, but the band played well [23]
- The show took place on Phil Lesh's 50th birthday [1]
- Uploader's last show ever, and the only one they saw in the Cap Centre run [11]
- Reviewer treats the show as a good warm-up for the 1990 summer tour [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-03-15.AUD.LaPorte.115935.Flac16**: taped by LaPorte; source: Unknown Mic > Unknown Deck > Marantz PMD 430 Tapers Section Floor section 128, row FF, seat 12; Master Cassettes > SB Audigy(line in) > Adobe Audition… [1]
- **gd1990-03-15.28293.sbeok.shnf**: source: Nak 300's > Sony D-5 (w/dolby B)> Maxell MX cass, Taper's section recorded by Boyd McHugh [2]
- **gd1990-03-15.140985.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Ultra Matrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-X90) [6]. Also: Ultramatrix soundboard transfer; two sets of masters were combined to make the show complete [6]
- **gd1990-03-15.142545.OTS.Schoeps.Mattes.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: flac16/48kHz ; Ted Mattes Master Recording: Schoeps CMC5 MMK4 (ORTF) > Aerco m1000 preamp > DAT 48k (Panasonic SV-250); Location: 1st row Tapers Section stand… [8]. Also: Taken from a DAT master supplied by Ted Mattes, recorded with Schoeps microphones [8]
- **gd1990-03-15.senn-hubbard.cpb.83675.flac16**: taped by Jeff Hubbard; transferred by Charles Bandrofcheck; source: Sennheiser 4xx's > Marantz PMDxxx > MC. [11]. Also: Taper Jeff would skip the drums if the tape ran out, so they may be cut [11]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1990-03-15 Thu Capital Centre, Landover, MD](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1249645169917/grateful-dead-1990-03-15-thu-capital) [28]
- Fan art by Dave Goodwich: [30th Anniversary of The Grateful Dead's Spring 1990 Tour: The Capital Centre, Landover, MD 3/15/90 - Glide Magazine](https://glidemagazine.com/241497/30th-anniversary-of-grateful-deads-spring-1990-tour-3-15-90-the-capital-centre-landover-md/) [29]
- Poster by Dave Goodwich: [30th Anniversary of The Grateful Dead's Spring 1990 Tour: The Capital Centre, Landover, MD 3/16/90 - Glide Magazine](https://glidemagazine.com/241539/30th-anniversary-of-grateful-deads-spring-1990-tour-3-16-90-the-capital-centre-landover-md/) [30]
- Fan art by RareVinyl.com: [Grateful Dead Terrapin Station: Capital Centre, Landover, MD 3/15/90 US 3-CD set](https://eu.rarevinyl.com/products/grateful-dead-terrapin-station-capital-centre-landover-md-3-15-90-us-3-cd-album-triple-set-gdcd4055-632430) [31]
